migrations.name: 0001_configuration_spine.sql
migrations.sql:
-- The initial Dial data model. This migration is immutable once released.
CREATE TABLE operators (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  normalized_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE magic_link_tokens (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX magic_link_tokens_operator_id_idx ON magic_link_tokens(operator_id);

CREATE TABLE operator_sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX operator_sessions_active_idx ON operator_sessions(token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at);

CREATE TABLE host_profiles (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  singleton_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (singleton_key = 'default'),
  handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  headline TEXT NOT NULL,
  biography TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE profile_focus_areas (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES host_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_focus_areas_position_idx ON profile_focus_areas(profile_id, position);

CREATE TABLE social_proof_entries (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES host_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quote TEXT NOT NULL,
  attribution TEXT NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_proof_entries_position_idx ON social_proof_entries(profile_id, position);

CREATE TABLE event_types (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published', 'disabled')),
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  color TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  listed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (listed IN (0, 1)),
  alternative_requests_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (alternative_requests_enabled IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE event_questions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  event_type_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('short_text', 'long_text', 'select')),
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (required IN (0, 1)),
  options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_questions_position_idx ON event_questions(event_type_id, position);

CREATE TABLE recurring_availability_windows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  event_type_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  weekday INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
  start_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439),
  end_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (start_minute < end_minute)
);

CREATE INDEX recurring_availability_event_type_idx ON recurring_availability_windows(event_type_id, weekday);

-- Date-specific availability replaces a recurring schedule for exactly one host date.
CREATE TABLE availability_date_overrides (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  event_type_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  host_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(host_date) = 10
    AND host_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
  ),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('open', 'closed')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(event_type_id, host_date)
);

CREATE INDEX availability_date_overrides_event_date_idx
  ON availability_date_overrides(event_type_id, host_date);

CREATE TABLE availability_date_override_windows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  override_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES availability_date_overrides(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  start_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439),
  end_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (start_minute < end_minute),
  UNIQUE(override_id, position)
);

migrations.name: 0004_provider_delivery.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Provider credentials, the privacy-minimal calendar cache, and durable delivery
-- commands. This migration deliberately has no dependency on booking tables added
-- later: booking and request IDs are opaque correlation identifiers here.

CREATE TABLE calendar_connections (
  singleton_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (singleton_key = 'default'),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider = 'google'),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('disconnected', 'healthy', 'unhealthy')),
  authorised_by_operator_id TEXT,
  account_email TEXT,
  access_token_ciphertext TEXT,
  refresh_token_ciphertext TEXT,
  access_token_expires_at TEXT,
  sync_cursor TEXT,
  channel_id TEXT,
  channel_resource_id TEXT,
  channel_expires_at TEXT,
  last_checked_at TEXT,
  last_successful_read_at TEXT,
  unhealthy_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE calendar_connection_calendars (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  calendar_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('destination', 'conflict')),
  conference_capable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (conference_capable IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(calendar_id, purpose)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX calendar_connection_single_destination_idx
  ON calendar_connection_calendars(purpose) WHERE purpose = 'destination';

CREATE TABLE calendar_push_channels (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  calendar_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  provider_resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(calendar_id)
);

CREATE INDEX calendar_push_channels_expiry_idx
  ON calendar_push_channels(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE provider_connection_health (
  provider TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google_calendar', 'resend')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('healthy', 'unhealthy')),
  last_checked_at TEXT,
  unhealthy_code TEXT,
  alert_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (alert_state IN ('healthy_announced', 'unhealthy_announced', 'unannounced')),
  alert_cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (alert_cycle >= 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE calendar_oauth_states (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX calendar_oauth_states_expiry_idx
  ON calendar_oauth_states(expires_at, consumed_at);

-- Only conflict information is retained. Provider event contents never enter D1.
CREATE TABLE calendar_busy_intervals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  calendar_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ends_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  transparency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'opaque' CHECK (transparency IN ('opaque', 'transparent')),
  deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (deleted IN (0, 1)),
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(calendar_id, starts_at, ends_at)
);

CREATE INDEX calendar_busy_intervals_lookup_idx
  ON calendar_busy_intervals(calendar_id, starts_at, ends_at, observed_at);

CREATE TABLE calendar_busy_read_windows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  calendar_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ends_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX calendar_busy_read_windows_coverage_idx
  ON calendar_busy_read_windows(calendar_id, starts_at, ends_at, observed_at);

CREATE TABLE delivery_outbox (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('calendar_upsert', 'calendar_cancel', 'mail_send', 'reminder')),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  booking_id TEXT,
  occurrence_id TEXT,
  request_id TEXT,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_error_code TEXT,
  succeeded_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX delivery_outbox_due_idx
  ON delivery_outbox(state, next_attempt_at, created_at);

CREATE INDEX delivery_outbox_booking_idx
  ON delivery_outbox(booking_id, occurrence_id, state);

CREATE INDEX delivery_outbox_request_idx
  ON delivery_outbox(request_id, state);

CREATE TABLE delivery_attempts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  outbox_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES delivery_outbox(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_number > 0),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('succeeded', 'retrying', 'failed')),
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  error_code TEXT,
  attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(outbox_id, attempt_number)
);

CREATE TABLE provider_webhook_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google_calendar', 'resend')),
  provider_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TEXT,
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  processed_at TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('received', 'processed', 'ignored')),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id)
);

CREATE TABLE operator_delivery_preferences (
  operator_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  booking_mail_muted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (booking_mail_muted IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Booking claims are kept independently of an event type's lifecycle. Event type
-- deletion removes future public availability but never removes confirmed records.

ALTER TABLE event_questions ADD COLUMN public_key TEXT;
UPDATE event_questions
SET public_key = 'q_' || lower(hex(randomblob(16)))
WHERE public_key IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_questions_public_key_idx
  ON event_questions(event_type_id, public_key);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  event_type_id TEXT,
  event_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_title TEXT NOT NULL,
  duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (duration_minutes BETWEEN 5 AND 480),
  location_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_value TEXT NOT NULL,
  invitee_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  invitee_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  host_timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  invitee_timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'rescheduled')),
  ical_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  calendar_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (calendar_state IN ('pending', 'succeeded', 'failed')),
  meeting_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (meeting_state IN ('pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'not_required')),
  meeting_url TEXT,
  current_occurrence_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancelled_reason TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX bookings_lifecycle_idx ON bookings(state, created_at);
CREATE INDEX bookings_event_type_idx ON bookings(event_type_id, state);
CREATE INDEX bookings_invitee_lookup_idx ON bookings(invitee_email, invitee_name);

CREATE TABLE booking_occurrences (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  booking_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence >= 0),
  start_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  end_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  occupied_start_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  occupied_end_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  host_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('current', 'rescheduled', 'cancelled')),
  is_current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_current IN (0, 1)),
  replaced_by_occurrence_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed_at TEXT,
  CHECK (start_at < end_at),
  CHECK (occupied_start_at < occupied_end_at),
  UNIQUE(booking_id, sequence)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX booking_occurrences_one_current_idx
  ON booking_occurrences(booking_id) WHERE is_current = 1;
CREATE INDEX booking_occurrences_conflict_idx
  ON booking_occurrences(occupied_start_at, occupied_end_at, is_current);
CREATE INDEX booking_occurrences_host_date_idx
  ON booking_occurrences(host_date, is_current);

CREATE TABLE booking_answers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  booking_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(booking_id, question_key)
);

CREATE TABLE booking_nonces (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  nonce_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('confirm', 'reschedule')),
  event_type_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  booking_id TEXT REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  selection_start_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  selection_end_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  invitee_timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT,
  payload_hash TEXT,
  result_booking_id TEXT REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX booking_nonces_lookup_idx ON booking_nonces(nonce_hash, expires_at, consumed_at);

CREATE TABLE booking_manage_tokens (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  booking_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  rotated_at TEXT,
  invalidated_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX booking_manage_tokens_lookup_idx
  ON booking_manage_tokens(token_hash, expires_at, rotated_at, invalidated_at);

CREATE TABLE booking_history (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  booking_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  occurrence_id TEXT REFERENCES booking_occurrences(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('created', 'rescheduled', 'cancelled', 'attendance_marked', 'calendar_cancelled')),
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('invitee', 'operator', 'calendar_provider', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  previous_start_at TEXT,
  new_start_at TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX booking_history_booking_idx ON booking_history(booking_id, created_at);

CREATE TABLE booking_attendance (
  booking_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('attended', 'no_show')),
  note TEXT NOT NULL,
  marked_by_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),

CREATE TABLE blocked_address_rules (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('email', 'domain')),
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(kind, value)
);

-- Retain only the salted random attempt identity after booking erasure.
-- Invitee payload hashes and booking references are deleted by the 0011 cascade.

BEFORE DELETE ON bookings
BEGIN

migrations.name: 0015_operator_notification_generation.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Each removal retires the recipient admission selected by in-flight producers.
-- Existing unversioned commands belong to generation zero, never a later invite.
ALTER TABLE operators ADD COLUMN access_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
-- A removal performed before this upgrade has already retired legacy authority.
UPDATE operators SET access_generation = 1 WHERE removed_at IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER operator_notification_generation AFTER UPDATE OF removed_at ON operators
WHEN NEW.removed_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.removed_at IS NULL
BEGIN
  UPDATE operators SET access_generation = OLD.access_generation + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;
END;

-- A producer may finish after both removal and re-invitation. Persist the failed
-- command visibly without granting authority from the newer admission. This uses
-- the same role/key/frozen-recipient rule as delivery/operator-mail.ts.
CREATE TRIGGER operator_notification_admission AFTER INSERT ON delivery_outbox
WHEN NEW.kind IN ('mail_send', 'reminder')
  AND (json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.recipientRole') = 'operator' OR
    (json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.recipientRole') IS NULL AND
      ((substr(COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.providerIdempotencyKey'), NEW.idempotency_key), 1, 11) = 'connection:'
          AND instr(COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.providerIdempotencyKey'), NEW.idempotency_key), ':operator:') > 11)
        OR (substr(COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.providerIdempotencyKey'), NEW.idempotency_key), 1, length('request:' || NEW.request_id || ':operator:')) = 'request:' || NEW.request_id || ':operator:'
          AND substr(COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.providerIdempotencyKey'), NEW.idempotency_key), -10) = ':submitted'))))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operators o WHERE o.removed_at IS NULL
    AND o.normalized_email = lower(trim(COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.wireMail.to'), json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.to'))))
    AND ((json_type(NEW.payload_json, '$.operatorAccess') IS NULL AND o.access_generation = 0)
      OR (o.id = json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.operatorAccess.id')
        AND o.access_generation = json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.operatorAccess.generation'))))
BEGIN
  UPDATE delivery_outbox
    SET payload_json = json_set(payload_json, '$.operatorAccessRevoked', json('true')),
      state = CASE WHEN state IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'failed' ELSE state END,
